headline: Samsung Electronics-SK hynix Leverage Regulation One Month…Which Stocks Did Retail Investors Who Sold 1.7 Trillion Won Move Into? [Investment 360]
summary: Retail investors net sold 1.7 trillion won of Samsung Electronics and SK hynix-related products since stricter single-stock leverage rules took effect. Daily average trading value this month fell to one-ninth of prior levels.
why: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix are leading Korean chipmakers and large weights in the KOSPI, so retail flows in their shares affect market liquidity.

impacts.why: Retail net selling of related products is reported, though the share price effect is not stated.
